description:
Runtime limits enforced by the Agent Orchestrator.

These are not task-specific — they apply to every task execution.
The Orchestrator owns enforcement of these limits; no other component
enforces them.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of RETRY decisions for a single node.
max_retries.title: Max Retries

max_replans.description: Maximum number of REPLAN decisions for a single task.
max_replans.title: Max Replans

global_timeout_ms.description: Maximum task execution duration in milliseconds. Per-task limit, distinct from the per-decision timeout_ms used by WAIT decisions. Enforcement is deferred to a future implementation phase.
global_timeout_ms.title: Global Timeout Ms
